ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni rang bzhin gyis rtag pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyi rtag pa yin no// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni rgyun mi chad pa ste/ chos la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir/ sprul pa'i sku ni rgyun gyis mi snang bar byas nas yang nas yang du sprul pa kun tu ston pa'i phyir zhes 'byung ngo*// mchan/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i mchog gi sprul sku gnyis cig car mi 'byung ba la dgongs pa'o// de lta min par zhing 'dir shāka thub ring la/ sangs rgyas gzhan 'byung ba gtan min na/ zhing 'dir dam chos pad dkar gsungs pa'i dus su de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang sogs dpag med byon pa dang*/ khyad par mchog gi sprul sku nyid kyis zhing 'dir rgyud kyi sprul bshad mdzad pa'i skabs/ rigs lnga rigs drug sogs sangs rgyas mtha' yas par byon pa thams cad dran par ma gyur tam/ der ma zad sangs rgyas 'di'i bstan pa'i ring la/ sngags lugs kyis tshe gcig lus gcig tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i in+d+ra bhū ti la sogs bgrang gis mi lang bar byon pa'ang ma yin nam/ sangs rgyas ji snyed byon pa thams cad zhing der mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston dgos so zhe na/ 'o na sangs rgyas shāka thub kyi 'khor du byon pa'i byams pa sogs kyis kyang ma nges la/ der ma zad/ phyi ma'i mur thug par skye 'phags chos smra ba'i 'khor du'ang skye ba sprul pa'i sku sangs rgyas 'byung du mi rung ba ma yin te/ rje btsun sgam po pa zla 'od gzhon nu'i 'khor du/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jigs/ seng ge sgra/ klu rigs sgron ma sogs kyi ngo bo/ rje phag gru/ dus mkhyen/ 'jig rten mgon po lta bu rnams byung ba nyid kyis de 'dra'i rigs gzhal gyis mi lang bas so// des na mi mjed kyi zhing gcig tu sangs rgyas stong las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas mang po 'byung ba 'di ni gdul bya theg pa chen po de dag la ches bstan pa yin te/

brgyad stong par/ dge slong khri bskal pa bzang po 'di la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par bshad la/ nyi khri snang bar/ grangs stong gi nges pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du bskal pa bzang po la grangs stong du grags pa nyid kyis thabs la mkhas pas gzhan sgrub pa dang dgag pa med par shes par bya ba'i don yin no// zhes 'byung la/ de'ang bskal pa bzang po la sangs rgyas stong du grags pas de gtso bor smos kyi gzhan bkag pa ni ma yin zhes 'chad par mdzad/ yang sangs rgyas mang po 'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu mi 'byung bya ba'ang sgra ji bzhin pa min te/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gcig tu shāka thub bye ba phrag brgya cig car 'byung ba lta bu nyid kyi phyir/ 'o na lung dang 'gal ba'ang min te sngon mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas gong gi rten gcig sangs rgyas pa na rten gcig po de gdul bya'i ngo bor mchog gi sprul sku dpag tu med pa 'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu 'byung yang sangs rgyas du ma cig car 'byung ba'i skyon med de/ rten gcig gis bsdus pa'i sprul pa'i sku yin pa'i phyir/ slob dpon legs ldan byed kyis rtog ge 'bar bar/ gnas gtsang ma na gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis bstan pa yang yin la sprul pa'i sangs rgyas de rnams tha dad pa'i sangs rgyas kyang ma yin te/ rten gcig pa'i phyir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las rab tu bkye ba'i 'od zer lta bu'am/ mi'i bdag po la rten pa'i bya ba byed pa'i skyes bu mang po bzhin du sprul pa rnams mang po nyid yin na mdzad pa gcig pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa ni mang po nyid ma yin par 'dod de/ des na 'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu sangs rgyas mang po 'byung ba ni gnas med cing skabs med do zhes bya ba dang yang mi 'gal te/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dbang du byas nas bstan pa yin gyi/

'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du ni ma yin pas so// zhes 'byung ba ltar 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'bri khung pa'i dgongs par 'chad na'ang mi legs pa min te/ 'bri khung pa nyid slob dpon klu zhabs yin la/ de'i dgongs 'grel chen po zhig slob dpon legs ldan byed yin pa'i phyir/ dgongs gcig rnying mar/ sangs rgyas la phrag dog mi mnga' bas/ sangs rgyas gzhan rnams kyang sangs rgyas de'i phrin las sgrub pa'i tshul du sangs rgyas de'i yab sogs mdzad bya ba dang*/ bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis mi 'byung ba bya ba bon 'bum gyi chos skad kho na yin par bshad pa lta bu 'dug pa'ang ches mi mdzes te/ sangs rgyas la phrag dog yod pa su la yang mi dwogs pa'i phyir dang*/ sangs rgyas ni sems can mtha' dag gdul ba la gzhan dring la rag ma las pas/ sangs rgyas nang phan tshun ched du grogs bya dgos pa ma yin pa dang*/ de ltar ched du grogs bya dgos na/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin las 'bad rtsol rtog pa dang bcas par yang thal dwogs par 'gyur ro// bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis mi 'byung ba bon mdor ma zad/ mdzod 'grel las/ lhan cig sangs rgyas gnyis min bzhin// zhes sogs gsung rab nas rgyas par gsungs pa nyid do// mdo las/ shā ri'i bu gal te la la zhig khyod kyi thad du 'ong nas 'di skad du/ da lta dge sbyong gau tam ma dang*/ 'di lta ste mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba la mnyam zhing mnyam pa 'ga' zhig yod dam zhes dri bar gyur na ji skad lan gdab/ de lta dri bar gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das dang mnyam pa ni 'ga' yang med do zhes lan gdab pa'o// ci'i slad du na/ bcom ldan 'das gnyis snga phyi med par 'jig rten du 'byung ba ni gnas dang*/ go skabs med do zhes bcom ldan 'das las thos shing mngon du bzung ba'i slad du'o zhes gsung zer ro// zhes mdzod kyi 'grel par drang ngo*// mchan/ zhes rten 'brel tshoms kyi gsung rgyun legs par bshad pa nyid grub bo//

thub mchog kho nas mkhyen pa las// gzhan gyis rtogs par bya min pa'i// rten cing 'brel 'byung chos kyi tshul// legs par sbyar 'dis 'gro ba kun// zla med dpal ldan dwags brgyud kyi// bstan pa'i nyi ma 'bar gyur cig// / phyi mo gnyis dang bstun nas legs par lan cig zhu'o/// / ༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dhi rastu/ deng 'dir gsung rab rin chen 'phrul par du// bzhengs dges legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum du// bgyis pa'i dge tshogs dri ma med pa rnams// gcig tu bsdoms te mthun rkyen sgrub rnams dang*// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe ring 'byor ldan zhing*// ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te// bla med rnam grol thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// bstan 'dzin dam pa gang na su bzhugs rnams// sku tshe'i rkyen gegs tha dag rab zhi nas// bstan 'gro'i don chen bla med mdzad bzhin du// dam chos bdud rtsi'i sbrang char 'bebs gyur cig /yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu lo legs shing*// nad mug 'khrug rtsod thams cad zhi ba dang*// mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags par// rdzogs ldan dang po'i lang tsho 'char bar shog /de'i mthus kha ba ris pa'i skye dgu'i yid// rnam dkar dge ba'i las la phyogs pa dang*// mthun rkyen legs tshogs gong nas gong 'phel te// dam chos 'dzin pa'i snod du rung bar shog /'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na pad+mo yi// zhabs pad bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir myur bkod de// zhi bsil chos kyi bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ror// longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang myur 'char shog /khyad par bstan pa'i snying po sgrub brgyud kyi// ring lugs dri med sa chen yongs khyab ste// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// sku tshe mi 'gyur tshe lha'i ngo bor brtan// phrin las mi zad nyi zla'i 'od dang sdeb// 'dus tshogs dge 'dun bgrang yas rgyu skar la// zab rgyas chos kyi gru char 'bebs par shog

/lha rnams mkha' la shis pa'i glu dbyangs len// 'gro rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i yun du 'tsho// klu rnams dga' bas nor 'dzin dbyig gis bkang*// mthar thug sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog / ces pa'ang 7 rgyal dbang karma pa o rgyan phrin las rdo rje mchog dgung grangs bcu gsum steng*/ 'og min mtshur phu'i gdan sar ljags rtsom gnang ba'i rten gsum gsar bzhengs kyi dge bsngo'i smon tshig byin rlabs can no/// /
